lessons.title: 7.1 Protists as Diverse Eukaryotes
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain the key concepts and mechanisms in Protists as Diverse Eukaryotes.

Protists are a diverse collection of eukaryotes that do not fit into the animal, plant or fungus kingdoms as traditionally defined. The group is polyphyletic rather than one natural evolutionary lineage. Many are unicellular, while some are colonial or multicellular. They inhabit aquatic and moist environments and may be photosynthetic, heterotrophic or mixotrophic. Protists are important producers, decomposers, symbionts and pathogens.

**Key terms:** Review the scientific terms introduced in this lesson and connect structure with function.

**Check your understanding:** Explain one mechanism from this lesson using a labelled sequence or comparison.

explanations.ur: پروٹسٹس یوکاریوٹک جانداروں کا متنوع گروہ ہیں جو روایتی جانور، پودے یا فنجائی گروہوں میں شامل نہیں ہوتے۔ یہ ایک ہی ارتقائی سلسلہ نہیں بلکہ مختلف نسبوں پر مشتمل ہیں۔ کئی یک خلوی اور بعض نوآبادیاتی یا کثیر خلوی ہوتے ہیں۔
explanations.sd: پروٽسٽس يوڪاريوٽڪ جاندارن جو متنوع گروهه آهن، جيڪي روايتي جانورن، ٻوٽن يا فنجائي ۾ نٿا اچن. هي هڪ ئي ارتقائي سلسلو نه پر مختلف نسلن تي ٻڌل آهن. ڪيترائي هڪ خليي وارا ۽ ڪجهه ڪالوني يا گهڻن خلين وارا آهن.

lessons.title: 7.2 Major Groups of Protists
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain the key concepts and mechanisms in Major Groups of Protists.

Protozoa are mostly heterotrophic and often motile; examples include Amoeba and Paramecium. Algae are photosynthetic and range from unicellular forms to large seaweeds. Myxomycota (slime moulds) have amoeboid feeding stages and produce spores. Oomycota are fungus-like organisms, often with cellulose-rich walls and aquatic or plant-parasitic lifestyles; they are not true fungi. Protists contribute to aquatic food webs and oxygen production, while some cause disease.

**Key terms:** Review the scientific terms introduced in this lesson and connect structure with function.

**Check your understanding:** Explain one mechanism from this lesson using a labelled sequence or comparison.

explanations.ur: پروٹوزوا عموماً غیر خودغذائی اور حرکت کرنے والے ہوتے ہیں، مثلاً امیبا اور پیرا میشیم۔ الجی ضیائی تالیف کرتی ہے۔ مائکسومائکوٹا سلائم مولڈز ہیں جبکہ اوومی کوٹا فنجائی جیسے مگر حقیقی فنجائی نہیں۔
explanations.sd: پروٽوزوا عام طور غير خودغذائي ۽ حرڪت ڪندڙ هوندا آهن، مثال طور اميبا ۽ پيراميشيم. الجي ضيائي ترڪيب ڪن ٿا. مائڪسومائڪوٽا سلائم مولڊ آهن، جڏهن ته اومي ڪوٽا فنجائي جهڙا پر حقيقي فنجائي ناهن.

lessons.title: 7.3 General Characteristics of Fungi
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain the key concepts and mechanisms in General Characteristics of Fungi.

Fungi are eukaryotic heterotrophs that absorb nutrients after external digestion. Their cell walls typically contain chitin. Most grow as hyphae forming a mycelium; yeast is unicellular. Fungi store glycogen and may reproduce sexually or asexually using spores. They are important decomposers and also form mutualistic associations such as mycorrhizae with plant roots and lichens with photosynthetic partners.

**Key terms:** Review the scientific terms introduced in this lesson and connect structure with function.

**Check your understanding:** Explain one mechanism from this lesson using a labelled sequence or comparison.

explanations.ur: فنجائی یوکاریوٹک غیر خودغذائی جاندار ہیں جو بیرونی ہضم کے بعد غذائی اجزا جذب کرتے ہیں۔ ان کی دیوار میں عموماً کائٹن ہوتا ہے۔ بیشتر ہائفے سے مائیسیلیم بناتے ہیں جبکہ خمیر یک خلوی ہے۔
explanations.sd: فنجائي يوڪاريوٽڪ غير خودغذائي جاندار آهن، جيڪي ٻاهرين هضم کان پوءِ غذائي جزا جذب ڪن ٿا. انهن جي ڀت ۾ عام طور ڪائٽن هوندو آهي. گهڻا هائفي مان مائيسيليم ٺاهين ٿا، جڏهن ته خمير هڪ خليي وارو آهي.

lessons.title: 7.4 Fungal Diversity and Reproduction
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain the key concepts and mechanisms in Fungal Diversity and Reproduction.

Traditional textbook groups include Zygomycota, Ascomycota, Basidiomycota and Deuteromycota (an artificial group for fungi with no known sexual stage). Zygomycetes form zygospores; ascomycetes produce ascospores in asci; basidiomycetes produce basidiospores on basidia. Modern fungal classification has changed with molecular evidence, so these textbook group names are useful for the stated syllabus but not all represent current formal phyla.

**Key terms:** Review the scientific terms introduced in this lesson and connect structure with function.

**Check your understanding:** Explain one mechanism from this lesson using a labelled sequence or comparison.

explanations.ur: درسی کتابوں میں زائیگومائکوٹا، ایسکومائکوٹا، بیسڈیومائکوٹا اور ڈیوٹیرومائکوٹا کے گروہ بیان کیے جاتے ہیں۔ ایسکومائسیٹس میں آسکس کے اندر آسکوسپورز جبکہ بیسڈیومائسیٹس میں بیسڈیا پر بیسڈیوسپورز بنتے ہیں۔ جدید درجہ بندی میں سالماتی شواہد کے باعث تبدیلیاں آئی ہیں۔
explanations.sd: درسي ڪتابن ۾ زائگو مائڪوٽا، ايسڪو مائڪوٽا، بيسيڊيو مائڪوٽا ۽ ڊيوٽيرو مائڪوٽا جا گروهه بيان ٿين ٿا. ايسڪومائسيٽس ۾ آسڪس اندر آسڪوسپور ۽ بيسيڊيو مائسيٽس ۾ بيسيڊيا تي بيسيڊيو اسپور ٺهن ٿا. جديد درجابندي ماليڪيولي ثبوتن سبب تبديل ٿي آهي.

lessons.title: 7.5 Uses, Ecology and Disease
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain the key concepts and mechanisms in Uses, Ecology and Disease.

Yeasts are used in baking and fermentation; fungi produce medicines such as penicillin and other bioactive compounds. Edible mushrooms are foods, while some fungi spoil crops or cause human and plant diseases. Mycorrhizae improve mineral and water uptake for plants; lichens combine a fungus with an alga or cyanobacterium. Decomposer fungi recycle nutrients. Fungal infections require appropriate antifungal treatment; antibiotics that target bacteria do not treat fungal disease.

**Key terms:** Review the scientific terms introduced in this lesson and connect structure with function.

**Check your understanding:** Explain one mechanism from this lesson using a labelled sequence or comparison.

explanations.ur: خمیر بیکنگ اور فرمنٹیشن میں استعمال ہوتا ہے؛ فنجائی سے پینسلین جیسی ادویات حاصل ہوتی ہیں۔ مشروم خوراک ہیں، مگر بعض فنجائی فصلوں اور انسانوں میں بیماری پیدا کرتی ہیں۔ مائیکورائزا پودوں کی معدنی غذائیت بہتر کرتی ہے۔
explanations.sd: خمير بيڪنگ ۽ فرمينٽيشن ۾ استعمال ٿئي ٿو؛ فنجائي مان پينسلين جهڙيون دوائون ملن ٿيون. مشروم کاڌو آهن، پر ڪجهه فنجائي فصلن ۽ انسانن ۾ بيماري پيدا ڪن ٿا. مائيڪورائزا ٻوٽن جي معدني غذا بهتر ڪري ٿي.

writtenQuestions.question: Discuss the structure, function and significance of the major systems or groups covered in Protista and Fungi, using examples.
writtenQuestions.modelAnswer:
Protists are a diverse collection of eukaryotes that do not fit into the animal, plant or fungus kingdoms as traditionally defined. The group is polyphyletic rather than one natural evolutionary lineage. Many are unicellular, while some are colonial or multicellular. They inhabit aquatic and moist environments and may be photosynthetic, heterotrophic or mixotrophic. Protists are important producers, decomposers, symbionts and pathogens.

Protozoa are mostly heterotrophic and often motile; examples include Amoeba and Paramecium. Algae are photosynthetic and range from unicellular forms to large seaweeds. Myxomycota (slime moulds) have amoeboid feeding stages and produce spores. Oomycota are fungus-like organisms, often with cellulose-rich walls and aquatic or plant-parasitic lifestyles; they are not true fungi. Protists contribute to aquatic food webs and oxygen production, while some cause disease.

Fungi are eukaryotic heterotrophs that absorb nutrients after external digestion. Their cell walls typically contain chitin. Most grow as hyphae forming a mycelium; yeast is unicellular. Fungi store glycogen and may reproduce sexually or asexually using spores. They are important decomposers and also form mutualistic associations such as mycorrhizae with plant roots and lichens with photosynthetic partners.

Traditional textbook groups include Zygomycota, Ascomycota, Basidiomycota and Deuteromycota (an artificial group for fungi with no known sexual stage). Zygomycetes form zygospores; ascomycetes produce ascospores in asci; basidiomycetes produce basidiospores on basidia. Modern fungal classification has changed with molecular evidence, so these textbook group names are useful for the stated syllabus but not all represent current formal phyla.

درسی کتابوں میں زائیگومائکوٹا، ایسکومائکوٹا، بیسڈیومائکوٹا اور ڈیوٹیرومائکوٹا کے گروہ بیان کیے جاتے ہیں۔ ایسکومائسیٹس میں آسکس کے اندر آسکوسپورز جبکہ بیسڈیومائسیٹس میں بیسڈیا پر بیسڈیوسپورز بنتے ہیں۔ جدید درجہ بندی میں سالماتی شواہد کے باعث تبدیلیاں آئی ہیں۔
rubric: بنیادی تصورات کی درست وضاحت (4 نمبر)

sd.question: Protista and Fungi ۾ شامل اهم نظامن يا گروهن جي بناوت، ڪم ۽ اهميت مثالن سان بيان ڪريو.
sd.modelAnswer:
پروٽسٽس يوڪاريوٽڪ جاندارن جو متنوع گروهه آهن، جيڪي روايتي جانورن، ٻوٽن يا فنجائي ۾ نٿا اچن. هي هڪ ئي ارتقائي سلسلو نه پر مختلف نسلن تي ٻڌل آهن. ڪيترائي هڪ خليي وارا ۽ ڪجهه ڪالوني يا گهڻن خلين وارا آهن.

پروٽوزوا عام طور غير خودغذائي ۽ حرڪت ڪندڙ هوندا آهن، مثال طور اميبا ۽ پيراميشيم. الجي ضيائي ترڪيب ڪن ٿا. مائڪسومائڪوٽا سلائم مولڊ آهن، جڏهن ته اومي ڪوٽا فنجائي جهڙا پر حقيقي فنجائي ناهن.

فنجائي يوڪاريوٽڪ غير خودغذائي جاندار آهن، جيڪي ٻاهرين هضم کان پوءِ غذائي جزا جذب ڪن ٿا. انهن جي ڀت ۾ عام طور ڪائٽن هوندو آهي. گهڻا هائفي مان مائيسيليم ٺاهين ٿا، جڏهن ته خمير هڪ خليي وارو آهي.

درسي ڪتابن ۾ زائگو مائڪوٽا، ايسڪو مائڪوٽا، بيسيڊيو مائڪوٽا ۽ ڊيوٽيرو مائڪوٽا جا گروهه بيان ٿين ٿا. ايسڪومائسيٽس ۾ آسڪس اندر آسڪوسپور ۽ بيسيڊيو مائسيٽس ۾ بيسيڊيا تي بيسيڊيو اسپور ٺهن ٿا. جديد درجابندي ماليڪيولي ثبوتن سبب تبديل ٿي آهي.
rubric: بنيادي تصورن جي صحيح وضاحت (4 مارڪون)

writtenQuestions.question: Evaluate the biological importance, applications and limitations of the concepts in Protista and Fungi.
writtenQuestions.modelAnswer:
Protozoa are mostly heterotrophic and often motile; examples include Amoeba and Paramecium. Algae are photosynthetic and range from unicellular forms to large seaweeds. Myxomycota (slime moulds) have amoeboid feeding stages and produce spores. Oomycota are fungus-like organisms, often with cellulose-rich walls and aquatic or plant-parasitic lifestyles; they are not true fungi. Protists contribute to aquatic food webs and oxygen production, while some cause disease.

Fungi are eukaryotic heterotrophs that absorb nutrients after external digestion. Their cell walls typically contain chitin. Most grow as hyphae forming a mycelium; yeast is unicellular. Fungi store glycogen and may reproduce sexually or asexually using spores. They are important decomposers and also form mutualistic associations such as mycorrhizae with plant roots and lichens with photosynthetic partners.

Traditional textbook groups include Zygomycota, Ascomycota, Basidiomycota and Deuteromycota (an artificial group for fungi with no known sexual stage). Zygomycetes form zygospores; ascomycetes produce ascospores in asci; basidiomycetes produce basidiospores on basidia. Modern fungal classification has changed with molecular evidence, so these textbook group names are useful for the stated syllabus but not all represent current formal phyla.

Yeasts are used in baking and fermentation; fungi produce medicines such as penicillin and other bioactive compounds. Edible mushrooms are foods, while some fungi spoil crops or cause human and plant diseases. Mycorrhizae improve mineral and water uptake for plants; lichens combine a fungus with an alga or cyanobacterium. Decomposer fungi recycle nutrients. Fungal infections require appropriate antifungal treatment; antibiotics that target bacteria do not treat fungal disease.
rubric: Evaluation of significance and limitations (3 marks)
